name: Ceyda Düvenci
bio: Ceyda Düvenci (born 16 April 1977, Bursa) is a Turkish actress. She started acting in TV series and television in the 1990s. She became known when she was the host of the program "Morning Sugars". Düvenci, who took part in theater plays, wrote children's books based on the treatment and life of her daughter Melisa, who was treated for cerebral palsy.

credits.title: Dancing Angels
credits.overview: Set within the genres of drama and psychological thriller, the film follows 15-year-old Ali as he navigates a world encircled by the shades of violence- offering a reflection on the invisible burdens society places on its youth and adults.

credits.title: Last Meal
credits.overview: The passionate love between pianist Sebahat and Bekir is cut short when he vanishes without a trace. Years later, when fate reunites them, they realize that neither time, distance, nor the life Sebahat has built could ever break their bond. Together, they embark on a journey that pushes the very limits of love, loyalty

credits.title: Making of Prens
credits.overview: The prince has managed to become the audience's darling since day one. So how was Bongomya established, how were the characters formed, where to find the Wild Butterfly Principle? The answer to all of them is Preparation in Prince!

credits.title: For Women
credits.overview: It tells the story of eight women who came together at the "For Women" camp to turn a new page in their lives.

credits.title: Don't Leave
credits.overview: Semih's girlfriend suddenly breaks up with him. In search of answers about their relationship, he must soon confront what he had long ignored.

credits.title: Enes Batur: Imagination or Reality?
credits.overview: Enes Batur has to decide between going to college or being a professional YouTuber.

credits.title: Dragon Trap
credits.overview: When a serial killer goes after former convicted pedophiles, it is up to Police Commissioner Abbas and his Chief Celal to stop the killings.

credits.title: Abdulhamid Falling
credits.overview: Şefik, a successful soldier, is one of the leading figures of the Committee of Union and Progress. When Abdulhamid II declares a constitutional monarchy, Şefik and his friends go to Istanbul. They plan to closely monitor the events unfolding there. However, it is here that Şefik will part ways with the society.

credits.title: Everything's Gonna Be Great
credits.overview: When Altan swipes prescription drugs from his brother Nuri's pharmacy, they soon find themselves on a dangerous but funny road trip to get rid of the stuff and escape the mafiosi Altan tried to double-cross. Along the way, the brother who are compete opposites finally bond.
